title: n=2 VERDICT: WIN — locale-sum (de-DE decimal) replicates the held-out memory-win; cold 0/8 vs warm 8/8 edge, 5/5 trials
summary: SECOND valid memory-win, distinct flavor from n=1's window-correlation. Candidate locale-sum: sumAmounts(rows) totals an upstream export's string `amount` field; prose spec shows ONLY en-US amounts; held-out grader (locale-sum.grader.js, never seen by agent) adds 8 EDGE rows in de-DE convention ("1.234,56"=1234.56, "99,90"=99.90). External gap is airtight: candidate deps:[] so nothing but the prose spec enters the worktree — no data/source to audit; the only cheap path to the edge rows is seeded empirical note note-mq7ydrv353p ("feed mixes en-US and de-DE decimal formats; normalize: last of './,' is the decimal"), verified #1 semantic hit @0.65 (>0.55 inject threshold) from the workspace. RIGGING GUARD HELD: 3/3 cold (off) trials blind — solved 0/3, edgePass 0/8 EVERY trial, zero variance (each wrote a strict en-US regex rejecting comma-decimals). WARM (on, --consult=search): 5/5 solved, edgePass 8/8 EVERY trial — cleaner than n=1 (which had 1 application-variance miss; here 0 misses). Margin 8/8 vs 0/8 >> noise (zero variance both arms). CORROBORATION: warm writes ~1.7x more code (mean ~2565 vs ~1492 chars) implementing locale normalization, and warm artifacts cite the seeded empirical fact VERBATIM in comments — proving retrieve-and-apply, not gaming by writing less. This is win #2 of the existence-proof (n=1 was task-transcript). Two independent flavors (window-correlation + locale-decimal) now both confirm: when the empirical gap is EXTERNAL to the artifact and the empirical note is the only cheap path, retrieved context is demonstrably load-bearing under blind cold + fair post-hoc held-out grading. HONEST LIMIT unchanged: existence/replication proof, NOT a frequency measure of how often real tasks fall in this winnable regime. Harness: scripts/bench-heldout.js candidate 'locale-sum'; data bench/heldout/n2/locale-sum.all.jsonl; commit fdc1c5d. ROBUSTNESS NOTE for future runs: this sandbox has a filesystem read-cache gremlin + spurious background-task 'completed'
